name: ironforge-gate-fog
about: Outside Ironforge's gate, at the foot of the mountain the city lies under. The fog was thick enough to hide the trees 60 yards off (2026-10-04, the owner at game time 17:39). Shots in the normal view and in Debug Views 12 (how much gets through) and 14 (where mist collects).

start.about: the owner's place, read with ComfyTest pos; the camera faced 108 degrees, 22 down, about 16 yards behind

expect.about: The road and the trees show through the fog (Debug View 12, white = clear): row 300 averaged 11 when the mountain lifted the fog's ground
